gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-cairo-play: Bruno Ace SC looks drawn with wire, every stroke a thin uniform line. Cairo Play is the sturdier reader, its open round letters staying clear at small sizes while the heading goes for show.
gen-gf-cabin-sketch-rubik: Rubik reads soft and clean, its lowercase looking big beside the capitals. Cabin Sketch is the loud one, stout pipe-cleaner strokes made for display, while Rubik keeps its round letters open and clear at small sizes.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-graduate: A horseshoe-wide c gives Cherry Swash its swagger, with diagonals as heavy as its verticals. Graduate is the dignified, bookish counterpart, spacing its letters generously, so the two feel like a showman beside a scholar.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-graduate: Bold and brash, Comic Relief draws bowls left open on one side. It makes a loud heading, while Graduate answers with bookish dignity, generous spacing between letters and capitals barely taller than its lowercase.
gen-gf-cousine-fs-ranade: Precise and technical, Cousine sets typewriter-width letters each in its own space. It's the one for tidy, mechanical headings, while Ranade is the organic one, its weight shifting slightly and its stroke ends sitting far apart.
gen-gf-cousine-montserrat: Montserrat reads geometric and friendly, with oversized e and a counters. Cousine is the one for crisp typewriter-style headings, each glyph isolated, while Montserrat glides along in sans-serif lines like drawn wire.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-fs-karma: Delius Unicase never tapers a stroke, so every line ends blunt and friendly. Karma is trustworthy and settled, its gently varied stroke weights and terminals clear of the stem letting a long passage glide along.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-fs-trench-slab: Trench Slab reads dignified and refined, with caps barely taller than its lowercase. Delius Unicase brings relaxed, rope-ladder spacing and curves that never thin, so it feels cozy and best taken a little at a time.
gen-gf-edu-au-vic-wa-nt-hand-fs-literata: Edu AU VIC WA NT Hand looks graceful and hand-drawn, its strokes never tapering where they meet or end. Literata carries a longer passage with sturdy hairlines and gently swelling rounds.
gen-gf-edu-vic-wa-nt-hand-fs-literata: Edu VIC WA NT Hand tucks small lowercase shapes beneath tall capitals, like quick handwriting. It suits big, brief headings, while Literata's sturdy thin lines and wide-mouthed curves handle the bookish serif work.
